title: 10 Best Car Body Shops Near Whitworth, Rochdale
excerpt: A breakdown of the top car body repair workshops around Whitworth and Rochdale. Check turnaround times, pricing, and key services.
content:
​

A dented bumper, a deep scratch, or a nasty scrape on your door panel can ruin your day. Living in Whitworth, you want a car body repair shop that is close by, fair on price, and quick to sort the damage. Rochdale and the surrounding villages have a good mix of small local garages and bigger accident repair centres, so there is no shortage of choice.

This list covers the top 10 car body repair workshops serving Whitworth and Rochdale. We checked business listings, customer reviews, and service pages to confirm each shop is real, active, and doing genuine bodywork repairs. Locations are included so you know how far each one is from Whitworth. Below, Car Body Shop takes the top spot, followed by nine other solid choices across the Rochdale area.

1. Car Body Shop

Car Body Shop is based in Whitworth, Rochdale, OL12 8HN, making it the closest full bodywork specialist to anyone living in the village. The workshop handles bumper repair, dent removal, scratch repair, full resprays, and alloy wheel refurbishment under one roof. It also takes on trade work for motor dealers and lease return repairs before the car goes back.

Car Body Shop has completed more than 5,000 repairs over 10 years of trading, and it keeps a 5-star average rating from customers. Most dent, scratch, and bodywork jobs finish within 1 to 2 days, which suits drivers who cannot be without their car for long. Customers can send photos over WhatsApp for a free quote before booking anything in.

Pricing stays transparent with no hidden charges added after the work starts, and the business is fully insured for every job it takes on. One customer said the shop fixed a dent on a lease car before return and it passed inspection with no issues. Another said the price beaten the local main dealer by a wide margin.

You can reach Car Body Shop on 07471 512557, open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:30pm and Saturday 9am to 1pm.

2. Castleton Motor Bodies

Castleton Motor Bodies sits on Trows Estate in Castleton, Rochdale, OL11 2UF, a short drive from Whitworth. The shop has traded since 1997 and covers dent and scratch repair, full body restoration, alloy wheel refurbishment, and commercial vehicle work including campervans.

  • Con: Sits in Castleton, so it takes longer to reach than shops in Whitworth itself.

3. Panelcare Ltd

Panelcare Ltd operates from Buckley Hall Industrial Estate on Buckley Road, Rochdale, OL12 9EF. The business has run since 1976 and covers paint refinishing, accident repair, paintless dent removal, wheel alignment, and valeting services.

  • Pro: Backs every repair with a 12-month warranty on parts and labour.

  • Con: The large industrial site handles many vehicle types, so smaller cosmetic jobs may queue behind bigger accident repairs.

4. Commercial Contract Engineers Ltd

Commercial Contract Engineers Ltd works out of Eagle Technology Park on Eagle Way, Rochdale, OL11 1TQ. The site covers 33,000 square feet and handles collision repair, major accident damage, colour matching, and chassis alignment checks.

  • Con: The facility focuses heavily on major accident and fleet repairs, so a quick scratch fix might not be its priority job.

5. Deans of Rochdale

Deans of Rochdale works from Unit 9, Firgrove Business Park, Belfield Mill Lane, Rochdale, OL16 2UJ. The shop covers dent removal, panel beating, and paintwork restoration, and it also helps customers with insurance claims.

  • Pro: The car park is wheelchair accessible, and staff are noted for honest, detailed service.

  • Con: The workshop closes on weekends, so you cannot drop off or collect your car on a Saturday.

6. M M Jig Repairs

M M Jig Repairs, run under the name Mark Moores Jig Repairs, is based at Stoneyroyd in Whitworth, OL12 8JL. This puts it right in the village alongside Car Body Shop. The workshop focuses on structural jig repairs and chassis realignment after accident damage.

  • Pro: Based in Whitworth village itself, so it is easy to reach without travelling into Rochdale.

  • Con: The focus on structural jig work means it suits accident damage more than light cosmetic scratches.

7. Milnrow Motor Co

Milnrow Motor Co sits on Newhey Road in Milnrow, Ro​chdale, OL16 4JD. The garage offers full resprays, dent repair, and wheel work alongside general bodywork services for local drivers.

  • Pro: A well-established local garage that covers both cosmetic bodywork and wheel repairs in one visit.

  • Con: Milnrow sits on the opposite side of Rochdale from Whitworth, adding extra travel time.

8. Magnum Car Panels Ltd

​

Magnum Car Panels Ltd trades from Graham Works on Regent Street, Rochdale, OL12 0HQ. The business has a long history supplying and fitting car panels alongside general bodywork repair.

  • Pro: Strong reputation for panel supply, useful if your repair needs a replacement part rather than just a respray.

  • Con: Panel supply work can mean a longer wait if your part needs ordering in first.

9. Nadeem Car Body Works

Nadeem Car Body Works operates from Unit 7, 8 Ashfield Road, Rochdale, OL11 1PX. The workshop specialises in car spraying and general bodywork repairs for everyday drivers.

  • Pro: Focused specifically on spraying work, which helps with colour matching on resprays and touch-ups.

  • Con: The smaller unit size may limit how many vehicles it can work on at the same time.

10. Nu Look Motor Bodies

Nu Look Motor Bodies is based on Buckley Road, Rochdale, OL12 9DL, close to the Panelcare site. The business covers sheet metal work and fabrication alongside standard body repair jobs.

  • Pro: Strong skills in sheet metal fabrication, useful for repairing rusted or structurally damaged panels.

  • Con: The fabrication focus means it may suit older or heavily damaged vehicles more than light cosmetic dents.

Final Thoughts

Whitworth drivers get the shortest trip with Car Body Shop and M M Jig Repairs, since both sit inside the village. For bigger accident repairs or fleet work, Castleton Motor Bodies, Panelcare Ltd, and Commercial Contract Engineers Ltd offer larger sites with insurer partnerships. Whichever shop you pick, always ask for a written quote and check the warranty terms before booking your repair in.

title: 5 Signs Your Car Needs a Respray in Rochdale
excerpt: Faded paint, rust spots, and mismatched panels? Here are five clear signs it’s time to respray your car — and what a professional respray in Rochdale typically involves.
content:
Paintwork takes a beating on UK roads — sun, rain, salt, and everyday bumps all add up. If your car is starting to look tired, a respray can restore its value and appearance. Here are five signs it might be time.

1. Faded or cloudy paint

If your bonnet or roof looks dull even after a wash, the clear coat may be failing. Once oxidation sets in, polish alone often isn’t enough.

2. Visible rust or bubbling

Small bubbles around wheel arches or door edges mean moisture is getting under the paint. Catch it early before it spreads into the metal.

3. Mismatch after a partial repair

One panel that’s a slightly different shade stands out in daylight. A full respray (or careful blending) gives a uniform finish.

4. Deep scratches through the clear coat

Superficial marks can sometimes be polished out. Scratches that show primer or bare metal usually need proper paintwork.

5. You’re selling or returning a lease

First impressions matter. Fresh paint helps at MOT time, on resale, and when handing a lease car back without penalty charges.

What a respray involves

  • Surface prep and any dent or rust repair
  • Colour matching to your factory code
  • Primer, base coat, and lacquer in a controlled booth
  • Curing time for a durable, glossy finish

title: How Much Does Car Scratch Repair Cost in Rochdale?
excerpt: Wondering how much it costs to fix a car scratch in Rochdale? Here’s what affects the price and how to avoid overpaying.
content:

So how much does car scratch repair cost in Rochdale?

Average Car Scratch Repair Costs

Here’s a general price guide:

  • Deep paint scratch: £250–£600

  • Keyed panel repair: £300–£800

The final cost depends on:

title: Dent Removal in Rochdale: Paintless vs Traditional Repair Explained
excerpt: Not all dents need repainting. Here’s the difference between paintless dent removal and full body repair in Rochdale.
content:
Dents happen more often than people expect. From door knocks to minor collisions, dents can lower the value of your car.

In Rochdale, we commonly perform two types of dent repair:

1. Paintless Dent Removal (PDR)

Best for:

  • Small dents

  • No paint damage

  • No cracked lacquer

Benefits:

  • Faster repair

  • Lower cost

  • Original paint preserved

Typical cost: £200–£500

2. Traditional Dent Repair

Needed when:

  • Paint is damaged

  • Panel is creased

  • Metal is stretched

This involves:

  • Filling

  • Sanding

  • Repainting

  • Blending

Typical cost: £400–£800

If you're unsure which repair your vehicle needs, send us photos and we’ll advise honestly.
author: Emma Davies - Customer Care Manager

title: Is It Better to Claim Insurance or Pay Cash for Minor Car Damage?
excerpt: For small car accidents, paying cash is often cheaper than claiming insurance. Here’s why many Rochdale drivers avoid claims.
content:
After a minor accident, most drivers ask:

“Should I claim insurance or pay privately?”

In many cases, cash repairs are smarter.

Why Avoid Insurance for Minor Damage?

  1. Excess fees can be high

  2. Premiums often increase

  3. Claims stay on record

  4. Longer repair process

If the repair costs £400–£700, it’s often cheaper to pay directly.

When Insurance Makes Sense

  • Major structural damage

  • Third-party involvement

  • High-value repairs

For bumper scuffs, scratches and small dents, most Rochdale customers choose fast cash repair.
author: David Lee - Senior Paint Specialist

title: Car Body Shop Rochdale: Complete Guide to Dent, Scratch & Bumper Repairs
excerpt: Looking for a reliable car body shop in Rochdale? Here’s everything you need to know about dent removal, bumper repair, and scratch fixes, including costs and repair options.
content:
If you’re searching for a trusted car body shop in Rochdale, chances are your vehicle has suffered some form of damage. Whether it’s a supermarket car park dent, a scraped bumper, or a deep scratch down the side panel, even minor cosmetic damage can be frustrating and reduce the value of your vehicle.

At our Rochdale car body repair centre, we handle everything from small scuffs to full panel resprays. The most common issues we see include bumper scuff repair, dent removal, paint scratches, alloy wheel damage and minor accident repairs. While the damage may look serious, many repairs are more affordable and quicker than drivers expect.

Dent removal in Rochdale is one of our most requested services. Small dents caused by door knocks or minor impacts can often be repaired using paintless dent removal techniques, which preserve the original paintwork and reduce costs. If the paint has been damaged, we carry out traditional repair methods involving filling, sanding and precise colour matching to restore the panel seamlessly.

Car scratch repair is another common issue. Light scratches can sometimes be polished out, while deeper scratches require repainting and blending into the surrounding panels. Modern paint matching technology allows us to achieve factory-level finishes so the repair is virtually invisible.

Many customers ask whether they should claim insurance or pay for repairs directly. For minor damage, paying cash often avoids increased premiums, excess fees and long waiting times. That’s why many Rochdale drivers prefer fast, affordable local repairs without the hassle of insurance claims.

If you’re looking for a reliable auto body shop in Rochdale that offers honest advice, competitive pricing and high-quality workmanship, the best step is to send clear photos of the damage. A quick assessment can help you understand the repair process and expected cost before committing.
